# mooncake vault add

Add or update an encrypted secret

## Description

Prompts for the secret value (echo disabled), encrypts it with your
Age identity's public key, and writes it to <MOONCAKE_VAULT_DIR>/<name>.age.

The <name> may include subdirectories, e.g. `db/password`.
Reference the secret in YAML as `!secret vault:db/password`.

## Flags

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|------|------|---------|-------------|
| `--recipient / -r` | string | - | Additional Age recipient public key (may be repeated) |
